s: The Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana is :

To facilitate patrolling of the area to prevent misuse
To help police to reach the place of crime more swiftly

s: Which of the following stations is not on the Trans-Siberian railway in Russia?

s: Trans-Siberian Railway runs between the stations in Russia from:

s: The longest continental railway in the world is
x: The Trans-Siberian (Moscow-Vladivostok, 9,289 km) is the longest continuous railway line in the world. The Canadian railways are shorter.

s: Which one of the following trains/railways passes through Germany, France, Austria, Hungary and Romania?
x: The Orient Express is the luxury train running Paris-Istanbul across central Europe, passing through Germany, Austria, Hungary and Romania. The Trans-Siberian and the Union/Central Pacific are in Russia and the USA.

s: Which one of the following cities is not located on the Trans-Siberian rail route?
x: Main cities located on the Trans-Siberian rail route from west to east are St. Petersburg, Moscow, Perm, Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Tyumen, Omsk, Novosibirsk, Krasnoyarsk, Ulan-Ude, Chita, Khabarovsk and Vladivostok. Note- The main track of Trans-Siberian Railway extends from Vladivostok to Moscow. By using a connecting service it can be traveled to Saint Petersburg in west. The city not on trans-Siberian rail route is Sochi. So, the correct answer is option (c).
